# Chargeback Analysis: Holiday Period Disputes

Consumer Disputes and Fraud drove holiday period volume increases, with Consumer Disputes showing the largest absolute dollar growth.

| Reason Category | Disputes (monthly avg) | Disputed $ (monthly avg) | Win Rate | Friendly Fraud Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Consumer Disputes | 333 [F1] | $206K [F1] | 55.6% [F1] | 0.0% [F1] |
| Fraud | 201 [F3] | $125K [F3] | 32.8% [F3] | 100.0% [F3] |
| Processing Errors | 40 [F5] | $24K [F5] | 50.0% [F5] | 0.0% [F5] |

- **Consumer Disputes increased 59% in volume** (333 [F1] vs 210 [F2]) and 67% in dollars ($206K [F1] vs $124K [F2]) during the holiday vs the prior three months, with win rate improving 3.2 percentage points to 55.6% [F1] (resolved disputes only in latest period)

- **Fraud disputes jumped 60%** (201 [F3] vs 126 [F4]) with disputed dollars up 63% ($125K [F3] vs $77K [F4]) during the holiday vs the prior three months, while win rate declined 2.4 percentage points to 32.8% [F3], all tagged as friendly fraud (100.0% [F3])

- **Processing Errors rose 54%** in volume (40 [F5] vs 26 [F6]) and 44% in dollars ($24K [F5] vs $17K [F6]) during the holiday vs the prior three months, with win rate declining 3.8 percentage points to 50.0% [F5]

## Data Coverage
Holiday period (Nov 2025-Jan 2026) compared with Aug-Oct 2025. CFPB complaints: 5,110 monthly market-wide benchmark [F1] for holiday period vs 4,676 [F2] for prior three months.
